origin: Distribution engine quality mandate — comment hijacks are high-stakes distribution actions; a low-quality comment wastes the slot and can damage brand. Substack email is a one-way door; Twitter/X posts are one-way door at scale.
description: Quality gate for comment hijack posts on LinkedIn and X/Twitter. Enforces four gates: hub_url present, freshness window, dedup, and standalone_value via LLM semantic judge (PROMPT.md + claude -p).
one_way_door_surfaces: twitter/x — cannot delete at scale once engaged
substack email — cannot un-send to subscribers (handled by substack-publish-gate)
gates: hub_url_present: hub URL must appear in comment_text (structural)
standalone_value: LLM judge via PROMPT.md + claude -p (semantic)
applies_to: LinkedIn comment hijacks on influencer posts
X/Twitter reply hijacks on high-engagement threads
Any distribution comment where the goal is driving traffic to a hub
litmus: Run HOW.py with full context JSON — exit 0 = safe to post, exit 1 = blocked with remediation
